name: Youth Volunteers
what_you_do: Teen volunteers help at one time events and posted openings, such as beach clean ups at Dr. Von D. Mizell-Eula State Park. The museum signs volunteer hours.
who_can_apply: Youth must be at least 14 and have completed 8th grade. Adult weekday session volunteers must be 18; teens use individual postings and one time events.
duration: One time events (a few hours) and posted openings
deadline_text: Teen openings are posted through the year. Listed beach clean ups: Sept 12 and Nov 7, 2026, 8 to 11 am.
how_to_apply: Sign up for an event on the volunteer page. No application is needed for the one time events.
notes: The museum only signs volunteer hours for students who are 14 (going into high school) or older.
